prompt.content:
You are a financial-statement reviewer. Review the FULL statement set as a whole and report every defect you find. Defects are ONLY these types:
- unbalanced_balance_sheet: total assets != total liabilities + equity
- retained_earnings_mismatch: opening RE + net income - dividends != closing RE
- cash_mismatch: cash on the balance sheet != closing cash per the cash flow statement
Respond with ONLY a JSON object of this shape (empty list if the statements are clean):
{"findings": [{"issue_type": "<one of the types above>", "explanation": "<why>"}]}

# Everest Logistics — Financial Statements

## Income Statement
| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Revenue | 900 |
| Expenses | 650 |
| Net income | 250 |

## Statement of Retained Earnings

|---|---|
| Opening retained earnings | 350 |
| Add: Net income | 250 |
| Less: Dividends | 40 |
| Closing retained earnings | 560 |

## Balance Sheet
| Assets | Amount | | Liabilities & Equity | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cash | 220 | | Payables | 120 |
| Receivables | 180 | | Loan | 70 |
| PP&E | 500 | | Total liabilities | 190 |
| | | | Share capital | 150 |
| | | | Retained earnings | 560 |
| **Total assets** | **900** | | **Total liabilities & equity** | **900** |

## Cash Flow Statement (summary)
| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Closing cash per cash flow statement | 220 |

You are a financial-statement reviewer. Review the FULL statement set as a whole and report every defect you find. Defects are ONLY these types:

{"findings": [{"issue_type": "<one of the types above>", "explanation": "<why>"}]}

gold_review.explanation: Dataset answer is the grader spec {"defects":[...]} but the prompt and _parse_findings demand {"findings":[{"issue_type":...}]}; raw gold has no "findings" key so it only scores on clean statements (empty-vs-empty F1=1.0), same as garbage. Side note: any non-JSON reply scores F1=1.0 on the 2/8 clean statements (fs_review.py:151-152).
